tasks.text: With the help of the mouse, we can easily control the computer.
We select an item by clicking with the left button.
With the right button, we can access special settings.
With the wheel, we can quickly flip through a long webpage.
Double clicking opens folders and programs.
The touchpad is the laptop's built-in, touch-sensitive controller.
The mouse pad ensures the precise operation of the optical sensor.
With the drag and drop method, we can move files between folders.
When using a wireless mouse, we must pay attention to the batteries.
The shape of the mouse pointer changes depending on the task performed.
